## Task

Link a roadmap item or describe one specific improvement.

## What I can contribute

Building, reference photos, measurements, Python, documentation or playtesting are all useful. Describe the proposed contribution and relevant context.

## Proposed first result

What could be reviewed independently? Mention the building, files or platform involved and any help you need. A proposed timeline is optional.

## References and permissions

List sources or assets you expect to use, if any. Do not include private data or material you cannot share.
